breakdown.title: The Water Rising in the Library

shot.text: First-person view from the dreamer's position in the yellow rowing boat, using a 24mm wide lens, camera at the height of their eyes sitting, looking straight ahead through the round window. In the foreground, the yellow interior of the rowing boat occupies the lower edge and bottom center, while the round window frame encircles the view with its edges visible at the sides and top. In the middle distance, just beyond the window opening, the water surface and the nearest rooftops and tops of trees protrude from the water, spread across the left, middle, and right thirds. In the background, the drowned city stretches to the horizon, with more rooftops and treetops receding, and the morning sky above. The light comes from the morning sun outside, entering through the round window and illuminating the boat interior and the scene beyond. Just outside the picture to the right, the sister is in the boat, rowing.
